name: CSIR Research Associateship (CSIR-RA)
funder: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Government of India
amount: Rs 36,000-40,000/month + HRA + Rs 20,000/year contingency (pre-2023 rates; current rates likely higher)
other_rules: PhD in science/engineering, or MD/MS/MDS, or ME/MTech/MPharm/MVSc with 3 years of R&D experience
at least one paper in a refereed journal
upper age limit 35 (relaxable 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, PwD and women)
total RA tenure under any agency capped at 3 years
notes: Selection by CV and interview. Stipend figures come from the ISTI summary last updated 2021; check csirhrdg.res.in for current rates and call dates, which were not listed.
